method.rho: Spearman over the eleven target tasks (round 1: original five, round 2: six added)
method.p_perm: two-sided permutation p, 20000 permutations of the gains, seed 17
method.ci_tasks: 95% percentile interval, 5000 resamples of tasks with replacement, seed 17
method.ci_noise: 95% percentile interval, 5000 draws of each task gain from a normal distribution with SE = (hi - lo) / 3.92 of its cluster-bootstrap interval (approximation, this script)
method.bold: p_perm < 0.05 and both intervals exclude zero
